text: Leigh Anne Vashni Uy do you have a B1 or A5 visa? I never processed CFO from the Philippines, my unrestricted visa from Israel has always been enough for immigration officers, I traveled back and fort and know many friends who also didn't have cfo and no issue in the airport. Usually, they are more strict with CFO if it's your 1st time going out of the country and you don't have yet a valid "fiance visa" from country of destination.  I think the OEC from the PH embassy in TLV I wrote in the article is more  relevant for your case.
